summary: ACM Research, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary, ACM Research (Shanghai), Inc., submitted a Record of May 2026 Investor Relations Activity to the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The record summarizes a May 14, 2026 conference call covering Q1 2026 results, new order growth of 65% YoY, and unchanged 2026 revenue guidance. No material definitive agreement, financial obligation, or special event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is reported. This is a routine regulatory filing disclosure, not a special situation.
